notes: Corrected: s010 is the second article of τὸν θεὸν τὸν δόντα, standing after an expressed head noun, so rule 31 empties it and gives *who* to the participle. The accepted reading applied rule 90, which is scoped to a substantival article and expressly blesses no unit in which a head noun is expressed.
A reference comparison will report the unrepresented s010 as a disagreement; rule 32's closing clause says such a report is not a correction.
